title: Pinlock 70 MaxVision Anti-Fog Insert
features: Anti-fog technology for clear vision in all weather conditions
MaxVision coating reduces glare and improves night riding visibility
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the Pinlock 70 MaxVision Anti-Fog Insert from Pinlock elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The Pinlock 70 MaxVision Anti-Fog Insert is an essential visual clarity upgrade from Pinlock. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
